# Whisk & Wonder Cakes

> Whisk & Wonder Cakes is an eggless home bakery in Arla, Palampur, Himachal Pradesh, India. Cakes are baked to order and priced per pound. The shop also sells party supplies and party bundles. Delivery is within about 10 km of Arla. Orders are placed on this website and confirmed on WhatsApp.

## About the business

- Name: Whisk & Wonder Cakes
- Type: home bakery, eggless cakes and desserts, plus a party store
- Location: Arla, Palampur, Himachal Pradesh, India
- Website: https://www.whiskandwondercakes.in/
- WhatsApp orders: +91 94597 55408 or +91 82199 38169
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/whiskandwondercakesofficial
- Google reviews: https://g.page/r/CZ0mtWwT_jKaEBM/review

## Cakes and prices

Prices are per 1 lb (500 g), in Indian rupees. A 2 lb cake costs twice the price, and so on. Customers can order from 1 lb up to 10 lb (5 kg).

- Red Velvet (Signature Layers): Rs 575 per 1 lb
- Black Forest (Timeless Classic): Rs 525 per 1 lb
- Pineapple (Fruity Favourite): Rs 375 per 1 lb
- Strawberry (Fresh & Fruity): Rs 425 per 1 lb
- Vanilla (Classic & Elegant): Rs 375 per 1 lb
- Butterscotch (Rich & Indulgent): Rs 425 per 1 lb

Weights: 1 lb = 500 g, 2 lb = 1 kg, 3 lb = 1.5 kg, 4 lb = 2 kg, 5 lb = 2.5 kg, up to 10 lb = 5 kg.

## Party store and bundles

Party items are priced on WhatsApp, so they are not paid on the website. Items include metallic balloons, pastel balloons, candles, banners and bunting, party caps and hats, and poppers with confetti. Bundles are also available. Their prices are confirmed on WhatsApp.

## Ordering and delivery

- Choose cakes on the shop section, then place the order on the website.
- Pickup from Arla, or home delivery within about 10 km. Delivery charge: Rs 20 for the first 1 km, then Rs 10 for each extra km. The exact charge is confirmed on WhatsApp.
- Payment: pay 50% now by UPI, the rest on delivery or pickup (as shown on the website).
- Reward codes: customers who submit celebration feedback after their order get a code for their next order.
